validation_notes: UTF-8 byte limits apply independently of JSON Schema character lengths. Duplicate keys and invalid Unicode are rejected.
Correct IDs must be unique, nonempty and present in candidates. URLs are canonical public HTTPS on port 443, unique and limited to 2048 UTF-8 bytes.
Registration total limit 65536 bytes; question and candidate evaluation projection limit 16384 bytes; completion total limit 16384 bytes.
PENDING evaluation fields except state are null. GRADED and COMPENSATED obey the exact decimal reward rule.
No per-answer public rows before irreversible answer closure. All objects are closed.
